units.source_text: 但是，这里说的“姑娘”，只是岛村这么认为罢了。

en.t: However, the "girl" spoken of here was only what Shimamura took her to be.

units.source_text: 她身边那个男人究竟是她的什么人，岛村自然不晓得。

en.t: What the man beside her actually was to her, Shimamura naturally did not know.

units.source_text: 两人的举动很像夫妻，男的显然有病。

en.t: Their behavior was very much like that of husband and wife, and the man was plainly ill.

units.source_text: 陪伴病人，无形中就容易忽略男女间的界限，侍候得越殷勤，看起来就越像夫妻。

en.t: When one is accompanying a sick person, the boundaries between man and woman are easily blurred without anyone noticing; the more devotedly one attends to him, the more they look like husband and wife.

units.source_text: 一个女人像慈母般地照拂比自己岁数大的男子，老远看去，免不了会被人看作是夫妻。

en.t: When a woman tends a man older than herself with almost motherly care, from a distance people inevitably take them for husband and wife.
